# Blog Customization Guide

This guide explains how to customize the blog's appearance and functionality.

## Quick Customizations

### Change Blog Title

Edit `_quarto.yml`:
```yaml
website:
  title: "Your Custom Title"
  description: "Your custom description"
```

### Change Color Theme

Popular Quarto themes:

```yaml
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo          # Current (modern, light)
    # OR
    theme: darkly         # Dark theme
    # OR
    theme: flatly         # Minimal, flat design
    # OR
    theme: litera          # Clean, professional
    # OR
    theme: simplex        # Very minimal
    # OR
    theme: spacelab       # Space-like
```

### Change Featured Image Size

Edit `index.qmd` listing config:
```yaml
listing:
  grid-columns: 2        # 2 columns (1, 2, 3, or 4)
  max-items: 20          # How many posts to show
```

### Add Social Media Links

Edit `_quarto.yml` navbar right section:
```yaml
navbar:
  right:
    - icon: twitter
      href: "https://twitter.com/yourhandle"
    - icon: github
      href: "https://github.com/yourorg"
    - icon: linkedin
      href: "https://linkedin.com/in/yourprofile"
    - icon: mastodon
      href: "https://mastodon.social/@yourhandle"
```

Available icons: twitter, github, linkedin, mastodon, instagram, facebook, youtube, email, rss

## Advanced Customizations

### Custom CSS

Create `custom.css` in root:
```css
/* Custom color for code blocks */
pre {
  background-color: #f5f5f5;
}

/* Custom link colors */
a {
  color: #0066cc;
}
```

Reference in `_quarto.yml`:
```yaml
format:
  html:
    css: custom.css
```

### Custom HTML Header/Footer

In `_quarto.yml`:
```yaml
website:
  page-footer:
    background: dark
    left: "© 2026 Your Company"
    center: "[Home](/) | [Blog](/posts) | [About](/about.qmd)"
    right: "Contact: hello@example.com"
```

### Modify Navigation Bar

Current structure:
```yaml
navbar:
  background: primary      # Color: primary, light, dark
  search: true             # Enable search
  left:                    # Left side links
    - href: index.qmd
      text: Home
  right:                   # Right side links (social icons)
    - icon: github
      href: "https://github.com"
```

Add more sections:
```yaml
navbar:
  left:
    - href: index.qmd
      text: Home
    - href: about.qmd
      text: About
    - text: Categories
      menu:
        - text: R Programming
          href: posts/index.html?search=R
        - text: ksTFL
          href: posts/index.html?search=ksTFL
```

## Site Structure Changes

### Add New Pages

1. Create `.qmd` file in root:
```bash
echo '---
title: "Resources"
---

# Helpful Resources

[ksTFL Package](https://github.com/...)
[R Documentation](https://r-project.org)
' > resources.qmd
```

2. Add to navbar in `_quarto.yml`:
```yaml
navbar:
  left:
    - href: index.qmd
      text: Home
    - href: resources.qmd
      text: Resources
```

### Customize Homepage

Edit `index.qmd`:
```yaml
---
title: "My Custom Homepage"
page-layout: full        # Remove sidebar
---

# Welcome!

Your custom content here...
```

### Create Archive or Categories Page

Create `archive.qmd`:
```qmd
---
title: "Post Archive"
---

## Posts by Category

```{r}
#| echo: false
# This would list posts by category
# Quarto may provide built-in tools for this
```
```

## Styling

### Font Changes

Add to `custom.css`:
```css
body {
  font-family: 'Georgia', serif;
  font-size: 16px;
}

h1, h2, h3 {
  font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif;
}
```

### Code Block Styling

```css
code {
  background-color: #f4f4f4;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

pre code {
  background-color: #f5f5f5;
  display: block;
  padding: 12px;
  border-left: 4px solid #0066cc;
}
```

### Link Styling

```css
a {
  color: #0066cc;
  text-decoration: none;
}

a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  color: #0052a3;
}
```

## Advanced Features

### Enable Code Tools

```yaml
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
    code-fold: false
    code-overflow: wrap
```

Options:
- `code-tools: true` - Add copy button to code blocks
- `code-fold: false` - Don't hide code by default
- `code-overflow: wrap` - Wrap long lines

### Search Configuration

Quarto search is automatic, but you can customize:

```yaml
website:
  navbar:
    search: true
    
# Search indexes all pages automatically
```

### Analytics (Optional)

Add Google Analytics or similar in `_metadata.yml`:
```yaml
website:
  google-analytics:
    tracking-id: "G-XXXXXXXXXX"
    anonymize-ip: true
```

### RSS Feed Customization

In `_metadata.yml`:
```yaml
feed:
  title: "My Blog Title"
  description: "Feed description"
  categories: [R, Programming]
  language: en
```

## Testing Changes Locally

```bash
# Preview with live reload
quarto preview

# Check specific rendering issues
quarto render

# Clean rebuild
rm -rf _freeze/
quarto render
```

## Performance Optimization

### Cache Rendering

```yaml
execute:
  cache: true
```

### Lazy Load Images

```yaml
format:
  html:
    lightbox: true  # Already configured
```

### Minimize CSS/JS

Quarto does this automatically in render mode.

## Mobile Responsiveness

Quarto is mobile-responsive by default. To test:

```bash
# Preview and check on mobile device
quarto preview
# Then visit from phone/tablet using local IP
```

## Troubleshooting Customizations

### Changes not appearing
```bash
# Clean cache and rebuild
rm -rf _freeze
quarto render
```

### CSS not applied
- Check file path is correct
- Ensure CSS syntax is valid
- Clear browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+Delete)

### Theme not working
- Verify theme name spelling in _quarto.yml
- Run `quarto render` to rebuild
- Check Quarto theme documentation

## Theme-Specific Options

### Cosmo Theme (Current)
- Clean, modern look
- Good contrast
- Professional appearance
- Recommended for technical blogs

### Darkly Theme
- Dark background
- Light text
- Good for eye comfort
- Less contrast for some elements

### Flatly Theme
- Flat design principles
- Minimal shadows/gradients
- Modern, simple look
- Smaller file sizes

## Common Customization Recipes

### Hide Table of Contents
```yaml
format:
  html:
    toc: false
```

### Make Posts Full Width
```yaml
page-layout: full
```

### Add Custom Sidebar
```yaml
sidebar:
  - id: nav
    contents:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
      - href: about.qmd
        text: About
```

### Dark Mode Toggle
Currently not built-in, but possible with custom HTML/JS
